summary: Seres Therapeutics filed an 8-K regarding an amendment to an existing asset purchase agreement with Nestlé S.A. (SPN) and a lease amendment. The APA Amendment terminates Nestlé's obligation to pay contingent sales milestones and eliminates milestone interest payments; Nestlé will pay $25 million in two installments on July 1 and October 1, 2026. The filing is a material definitive agreement but does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review; it modifies prior contractual terms. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms beyond the $25 million payment are stated. This is a routine contractual amendment, not a transformative event.
